name.value: Days Inn by Wyndham 100 Mile House

description.value: Days Inn by Wyndham 100 Mile House is a mid-range chain hotel situated in 100 Mile House, a service hub in BC's Cariboo region along Highway 97. It sits at a natural stopping point for cyclists travelling the Interior plateau between Cache Creek and Williams Lake. As part of the Wyndham Rewards program, it offers the typical Days Inn suite of standard room amenities.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content fetched is almost entirely Wyndham corporate navigation boilerplate and booking-interface markup; no property-specific amenity details for this 100 Mile House location were returned. Some subpages fetched (Hawthorn Extended Stay, WaterWalk) belong to entirely different Wyndham sub-brands, suggesting the crawl captured generic site pages rather than the specific hotel overview. As a result, only the OSM tags (internet_access=wlan, phone, address) are available as evidence, but per rules OSM amenity tags cannot be treated as authoritative without website confirmation, so nearly all amenity fields remain null.
concerns: Website crawl returned mostly generic Wyndham corporate navigation boilerplate; property-specific content (amenities, room details, address confirmation) was not captured. Some fetched subpages (Hawthorn Extended Stay, WaterWalk) belong to different Wyndham sub-brands, suggesting the crawler pulled generic site-wide pages. A manual check of the property page is recommended to verify amenities and contact details.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, publicly bookable chain hotel at a logical overnight stop for cyclists on Highway 97 through the Cariboo. No grounds for exclusion.
enrichment_extras.notes: OSM tags include internet_access=wlan, but this could not be confirmed via website content due to the fetch returning only generic corporate pages.
